name: Suou Amane
source:
A third-year student of Mihama Academy, the Onee-san type who always takes care of others. For some circumstances, Amane skipped one year of school at her previous school, so she is actually 2 years older than [url=/c567]Yuuji[/url]. She is tall and has a very curvy body. Her family manages a long-established restaurant in Ginza, so she is a good cook. Because her mother comes from Kyoto, whenever Amane gets excited or panics, she usually starts talking in Kansai dialect. Amane also has a deep interest in cars and has acquired automatic two-wheeled vehicle license. She has a dirt bike which was remodeled to a cruiser called “Boba Tarou” (ボバ太郎) and put in to the garage of the academy.

Her representative fruit is cherry.

[From Shiori-chan's review]
